title: Cosine Sunset
description: Paint an animated sunset with one cosine palette. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 (aspect-corrected, centred). The palette is pal(t) = a + b * cos(6.28318 * (c * t + d)) with a = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5), b = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5), c = (1, 1, 1) and d = (0.00, 0.10, 0.20). The sky is pal(0.30 + 0.25 * uv.y) and never moves. The sun is centred at (0, -0.6). With r its distance, the sun's rings are pal(2.0 * r - u_time / 8.0), so they flow outward and repeat every 8 seconds. Blend from the rings to the sky with smoothstep(0.35, 0.75, r).
